description: Database freshness: CVE/KEV/CWE counts and latest entries, and the sync state of each upstream feed. last_synced is when a feed's state was last written; read it with last_status. Costs no credits.
name: health

charged.description: Credits this call cost; 0 for a free tool.

remaining.description: Credits left in the budget window. Absent when not paid from a credit budget.

last_status.description: ok, error or in_progress. May be empty.

last_synced.description: UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ when the feed's state was last written, not its last success. May be null.

records_updated.description: The count that the feed's last run recorded with last_status. Each feed counts its own unit.

date_added.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty when the table is empty.

published_time.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Empty when the table is empty.

status.description: Always ok in a result. A database the server cannot read gives a protocol error instead.

title: Health and Data Freshness
